title: Allu Arjun Faces Backlash Over Independence Day Post, Deletes It
excerpt: The Pushpa star's social media post on August 15 drew criticism from netizens, adding to a series of controversies that have trailed the Telugu superstar in recent months.
body:
• Pushpa star Allu Arjun faced criticism on social media over his Independence Day post on August 15, ultimately deleting it amid backlash.
  • The actor has regularly shared patriotic messages on Independence Day in previous years without incident.
  • The controversy comes months after Allu Arjun navigated the Pushpa 2 premiere stampede tragedy and a separate podcast controversy.
  • Allu Arjun is currently filming director Atlee's sci-fi project and has signed on for a film with Lokesh Kanagaraj.

Pushpa Star's Post Sparks Online Debate

https://youtube.com/watch?v=L8w5h8b4Qvw

Telugu superstar Allu Arjun found himself at the center of yet another social media controversy after his Independence Day post on August 15 drew criticism from sections of netizens, leading the actor to delete the post, according to multiple reports from entertainment outlets.

The incident marks the latest in a series of public controversies that have dogged the Pushpa star over the past year, from the deadly stampede at the Pushpa 2 premiere in Hyderabad to a podcast controversy earlier in 2026 involving alleged "dos and don'ts" demands.

Allu Arjun, who commands a massive following of over 20 million on X (formerly Twitter), has traditionally shared patriotic messages on India's Independence Day. In 2025, he tweeted "Happy 79th Independence Day to all of us. Jai Hind" with an image of the Indian flag. Similar messages in previous years were met with overwhelmingly positive responses from fans.

Pattern of Controversies

The actor's decision to delete the post suggests his team assessed the backlash as significant enough to warrant removal — a move that itself generated additional commentary on social media, with some supporters arguing the criticism was unwarranted and others pointing to it as part of a broader pattern.

The Independence Day controversy follows a turbulent period for the actor. In December 2024, a woman was killed in a stampede at the premiere of Pushpa 2: The Rule at Sandhya Theatre in Hyderabad. Allu Arjun was briefly detained in connection with the incident and later announced Rs 2 crore in financial support for the victim's family. He subsequently held a press conference addressing the matter, which itself drew mixed reactions.

"Certain recent comments made about Mr Allu Arjun are completely baseless and untrue. He has always conducted himself with the utmost dignity and honour."

— Allu Arjun's team, in a statement earlier this year

Recent Backlash Over Fan Event Remarks

More recently, in July 2026, Allu Arjun faced criticism after comments he made at a fan club summit in Hyderabad were interpreted by some as encouraging stalking. During the event, the actor told fans, "If you don't like someone, don't waste time hating and trolling them. Spend time doing something you like. Go wait in front of the girl you like's house instead," according to Pinkvilla. The remark quickly went viral, with social media users questioning whether the actor considered the influence he holds over his fan base.

Earlier in 2026, the actor's team issued a strong rebuttal after a brand strategist claimed on a podcast that Allu Arjun had a list of "42 dos and don'ts" for industry professionals. The claim was later retracted, with the brand strategist issuing a public apology and the podcast episode being deleted.

Professional Commitments Continue

Despite the recurring controversies, Allu Arjun remains one of Indian cinema's most bankable stars. He is currently filming director Atlee's sci-fi project, tentatively called AA22xA6, alongside Deepika Padukone. The actor has also signed on for a project with acclaimed director Lokesh Kanagaraj, known for the Kaithi-Vikram cinematic universe.

Pushpa 2: The Rule grossed over Rs 1,100 crore at the Indian box office despite the controversies, making it one of the highest-grossing Indian films of 2024. A third installment in the Pushpa franchise is also reportedly in development.

The repeated controversies have led some industry observers to question the effectiveness of Allu Arjun's public relations management, with commentators noting that prompt and calibrated responses could have contained several of the situations that escalated on social media.
nri_angle: Allu Arjun is one of Indian cinema's biggest global stars with a massive following among the diaspora, making his public controversies closely watched internationally.
